final_message:
All four functions are implemented in `src/`, and 11 of 12 tests pass. The one failure is `reads the live queue_depth series`, which calls the real `metrics.ops.internal` service. It fails with `fetch failed` because this sandbox has no network access, the same as CI. I left that test unchanged.

- `src/series.ts`: `parseSeries` validates `samples`, `t` (non-negative integer, strictly increasing) and `v` (finite), and throws `MetricsError` otherwise.
- `src/client.ts`: `MetricsClient` strips a trailing `/` from `baseUrl`, validates the metric name and window before any request (`RangeError`), and maps fetch rejections, non-2xx statuses and non-JSON bodies to `MetricsError`.
- `src/rules.ts`: `evaluateRule` and `findIncidents` validate the rule (`RangeError`) and implement the breach-run logic from the README.

The `apply_patch` tool was unavailable in this session, so I applied the edits with the shell `apply_patch` command. That left a stray `}` at the end of `src/rules.ts`, which I removed.
